chlorophyll_a.expected_source: MODIS Aqua L3 mapped monthly chlorophyll-a
chlorophyll_a.experiment_action: availability and temporal-gap negative result only; no synthetic fill and no training branch

mixed_layer_depth.experiment_action: unavailable negative result; no training branch

river_discharge.workspace_status_at_preregistration: no frozen discharge or runoff product
river_discharge.experiment_action: unavailable negative result; river geometry is not used as freshwater flux

dense_front_proxy.definition: water-connected cardinal-neighbour mean absolute difference and range at the same grid month
dense_front_proxy.fallback: zero-valued contrast plus explicit valid-neighbour count

freshwater_proxy.definition: background-SSS freshwater deficit relative to 35 plus water-connected local contrast and range
freshwater_proxy.fallback: zero-valued proxy plus explicit background availability and valid-neighbour count

circulation_proxy.definition: water-connected cardinal-neighbour ADT mean absolute difference and range
circulation_proxy.fallback: zero-valued proxy plus explicit availability and valid-neighbour count
circulation_proxy.production_status: optional; may not reduce product coverage

continuous_background.definition: outer-training-only continuous spherical-seasonal-trend Ridge background using unit-sphere coordinates, annual harmonics, trend, and their interactions

training.outer_splits: exact Issue-61 cruise, geographic plus 100 km buffer, whole-region, and past-only forward indices
training.inner_selection: same complete-group inner split and six-configuration allowance as Issue 62
training.outer_calibration: same isolated complete-group calibration partition as Issue 61
training.combination_policy: do not combine factors in Issue 63; combinations belong to Issue 64 only if single-factor evidence retains both

retention_gate.unavailable_source_policy: archive as unavailable negative evidence without inventing a proxy bearing the source name

artifacts.caption_policy: full caption immediately below every figure in REPORT.md
